issue.title: Colon-form %wait comma-space lists are truncated by the runtime parser
issue.description: Completion currently offers comma-space target lists such as `%wait:planner, coder`, but the runtime colon-directive parser stops at the first whitespace and waits on `planner` only. Either the runtime grammar should accept `, ` inside colon-form wait lists or completion should stop offering that shape.

task_type_fields.impact: The prompt input and LSP can lead users to believe they are waiting on multiple agents, while launch/runtime behavior silently waits on only the first target.
task_type_fields.repro: .venv/bin/python -c "from sase.xprompt.directives import extract_prompt_directives; print(extract_prompt_directives('%wait:planner, coder')[1].wait)" prints ['planner'] instead of ['planner', 'coder'].
